items.q: Is this an instant voice translator app?
items.a: Yes — tap the mic and speak, your voice is translated a few seconds after you stop talking, shown as text and available to hear read aloud.
Yes, it's a full Spanish speech translator among 186 supported languages — pick any pair and start talking.

items.q: Do I need to download anything?
items.a: No. It runs right in your browser — no app store, no installs.
No. Try it on this page with no sign-up. Sign in with Google only for more daily credits and synced history.

items.q: Can I use text instead of voice?
items.a: Yes, switch to keyboard mode any time and type instead of speaking.
